name: aha-playbook
description: Engineering, design, and project practices as installable plugins

plugins.name: playbook-core
plugins.description: Domain-neutral working agreement: stop conditions, work gates, communication

plugins.name: playbook-eng
plugins.description: Software engineering practices: design gates, code quality, security, testing, documentation, and generated artifacts

plugins.name: playbook-swift
plugins.description: Swift and SwiftUI practices: language conventions, concurrency, testing, SwiftUI architecture and performance, and iOS instrumentation. Enable per Swift project

plugins.name: playbook-flutter
plugins.description: Dart and Flutter practices: conventions, layered architecture, and theming. Enable per Flutter project

plugins.name: playbook-android
plugins.description: Native Android practices: the instrumentation every release ships with. Enable per Android project

plugins.name: playbook-design
plugins.description: UI and UX design practices: UX design briefs for consumer mobile apps, accessibility, and SwiftUI implementation guidance
